title: cli: os migrate summary-nulls refuses to boot an app that declares queues and assignmentRules ("no 'ownership-queue' service is registered"), so the summary backfill cannot run on a queue-using app
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

## What happens (@objectstack 18.4.0, HotCRM, 2026-11-15)

HotCRM 1b (hotcrm#2464) adds summary fields to `crm_contract` and `crm_account` through objectExtensions. A summary declared after its parent rows exist reads blank on those rows until a child row is written, and `os migrate summary-nulls` is the documented backfill. Run against the HotCRM stack, it refuses to boot:

> declares queues (2) and assignmentRules (2), but no 'ownership-queue' service is registered

HotCRM adopted ADR-0142 queues (hotcrm#2402). `os serve` registers the ownership-queue service, but the migrate command's boot does not. So any app that uses queues cannot run the summary backfill.

## Ask

The `os migrate` boot registers the services that the stack's declared metadata needs (here ownership-queue), or treats queue and assignment-rule metadata as inert for a data migration. Either way, `os migrate summary-nulls` must run on a queue-using app.

## Acceptance

1. `os migrate summary-nulls` (preview and apply) runs on a stack that declares queues and assignmentRules, and fills the new summaries on existing parent rows.
2. Other `os migrate` subcommands that boot the stack get the same fix, or each is shown not to need it.
3. A regression test boots a fixture app with one queue and one assignment rule through the migrate path.
